name: print-social-thank-you-post-with-purple-pixel-glow-and-uppercase-details
title: Design resource post with big Thank You headline over a glowing violet pixel gradient
whatItIs: A pale grid-lined portrait with 'Thank You!' in heavy black and violet, a small follow prompt, and a soft violet-to-white pixelated gradient across the lower half with a small button, resource title lines and tiny corner text ending with a save icon.
whatItMeans: Clean and modern; the pixel glow gives a light post digital depth.
techniques: Colour 'You!' in violet to create a two-tone title.
Use a pixelated gradient block as the visual.
Keep tiny caps details in the corners.
Add save-for-later cue at the bottom.

vocabulary.definition: A colour fade made from square tiles.
A prompt with a bookmark icon.
Small text set in the four corners.
